obligations.statement: The product must be mountable on a wall, with a wall mounting feature that constrains the dispenser relative to the wall.
derivation_premises: A product that is not mounted on a wall cannot be wall-mounted.

obligations.statement: A storage volume must exist within the product that can hold approximately twenty small items, with an upper bound on capacity.
derivation_premises: Items that are not contained within the product cannot be dispensed.

obligations.statement: A lever must be accessible to the user and operable by a manual press to initiate dispensing.
derivation_premises: A lever that cannot be reached or pressed cannot be operated by the user.

obligations.statement: The internal mechanism must be capable of separating a single item from the bulk and releasing it at a delivery point.
derivation_premises: If items are not individually isolated, more than one might be released.

obligations.statement: The dispensing mechanism must ensure that at most one item is released per actuation cycle.
derivation_premises: If more than one item is released, the mechanism fails to meet the functional requirement.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must include a top opening that allows refilling of items while the dispenser remains mounted on the wall.
derivation_premises: Refilling from the top requires an opening on the top surface that is accessible while the dispenser is attached.

obligations.statement: The refilling path must clear the wall mounting and the dispenser structure, allowing items to be inserted without removal.
derivation_premises: If the wall mounting obstructs the refilling, items cannot be added from the top.

obligations.statement: The dispenser must not jam in the nearly empty state, meaning that items must continue to move toward the release mechanism when few remain.
derivation_premises: If the remaining items cannot reach the release area, the dispenser will not output an item, which is a form of jamming.

load_cases.applied_to_role: the wall the product is mounted on

candidates.summary: A gravity-fed dispenser using a rotating indexer to separate items.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Can analyze the rotary indexing motion for single-item dispensing.

candidates.summary: A gravity-fed dispenser using a gated pair of shutters to release one item at a time.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Can analyze the gate motion to ensure it passes one item per cycle.

candidates.summary: A dispenser with a vertical magazine and a slider that pushes out the bottom item.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Kinematic analysis can verify the slider motion and pocket alignment.

unresolved.decision: The exact mechanism for separating a single item from the bulk and ensuring no jamming near emptiness is not finalized.
unresolved.why_open: Multiple principle families (indexing rotor, gated pair, single-item pocket) could each satisfy the obligations, and the choice depends on the exact capacity and behavior near empty, which is ambiguous.

assumptions.statement: The small items are uniform enough that the dispenser can be designed to hold and release them as described.
assumptions.why: The text assumes compatibility with the stated functions.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the items vary greatly in size or shape.
